alibabacloud-sas-vul-repair 0.0.1 – Initial release

- Enables querying and filtering vulnerabilities in Alibaba Cloud Security Center (SAS) by severity, type, asset, and status.
- Supports triggering vulnerability repair actions, post-fix re-verification, and interpreting repair failure error codes (e.g., 8009, 8037, 9003).
- Provides troubleshooting guidance for common issues (repository/network errors, "fixed but still detected", etc.).
- Offers manual repair procedures for non-standard systems (self-compiled kernels, non-Alibaba Cloud hosts, offline environments, custom images, EOL systems).
- Strictly documents installation, authentication, supported RAM permissions, and error handling processes.
